content: How much in-force annual premium has Lakefront Brokerage Partners produced?

name: query_salesforce

content: [Lakefront Brokerage Partners](/lightning/r/001aj000040t3cmAAA/view) has placed **52 policies in force** (Active or Pending Renewal), worth **$1,138,520** in annual premium. That's about 62% of the org's $1,823,578 in force.
